biological.citation: Small Extracellular Vesicles From Brown Adipose Tissue Mediate Exercise Cardioprotection (PMID: 35387487)
biological.summary: MAP2K7 is identified as a target molecule in the proapoptotic MAPK pathway that is suppressed by cardioprotective miRNAs (miR-125b-5p, miR-128-3p, miR-30d-5p) delivered via brown adipose tissue-derived small extracellular vesicles. The BAT miRNAs cooperatively suppress MAPK pathway activation by targeting Map2k7 along with Map3k5 and Map2k4 in the signaling cascade.

biological.citation: Pharmacological inhibition of the MAP2K7 kinase in human disease (PMID: 39717752)
biological.summary: MAP2K7 is a kinase that activates c-Jun NH2-terminal protein kinase (JNK) in response to stress signals including inflammatory cytokines, osmotic stress, and genomic damage. The review discusses MAP2K7 as a therapeutic target for cancer and the development of small-molecule inhibitors to enhance specificity in disease treatment.

biological.citation: Artesunate Nanoplatform Targets the Serine-MAPK Axis in Cancer-Associated Fibroblasts to Reverse Photothermal Resistance in Triple-Negative Breast Cancer (PMID: 40528526)
biological.summary: MAP2K7 is identified as the most potential target in the serine-MAPK axis for sensitizing photothermal therapy in triple-negative breast cancer. Artesunate disrupts serine homeostasis and attenuates cascade activity of GTPases in the MAPK pathway, with MAP2K7 emerging as a key node for overcoming photothermal resistance.

biological.citation: BRD4/MAP2K7/PGF Signaling Axis Promotes Senescence and Extracellular Matrix Metabolism of Nucleus Pulposus Cells in Intervertebral Disk Degeneration (PMID: 40130513)
biological.summary: MAP2K7 is a downstream target of BRD4 that enhances PGF expression, promoting nucleus pulposus cell senescence and extracellular matrix degradation in intervertebral disk degeneration. BRD4 upregulates MAP2K7, which then increases PGF expression, linking this kinase to age-related degenerative disease pathology.
biological.sample_size: human IDD patients and age-related rat model

biological.citation: The EEF1AKMT3/MAP2K7/TP53 axis suppresses tumor invasiveness and metastasis in gastric cancer (PMID: 35753528)
biological.summary: MAP2K7 is a substrate of the methyltransferase EEF1AKMT3, which catalyzes monomethylation of MAP2K7 at K296, thereby decreasing MAP2K7 phosphorylation, ubiquitination, and degradation of TP53. This methylation-dependent regulation of MAP2K7 suppresses tumor invasiveness and metastasis in gastric cancer.

biological.citation: Rational Design of Highly Potent and Selective Covalent MAP2K7 Inhibitors (PMID: 37197477)
biological.summary: MAP2K7, also known as MEK7 and MKK7, is a protein kinase of great interest in pediatric T-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia (T-ALL) pathophysiology. The study describes the rational design and synthesis of novel irreversible MAP2K7 inhibitors with favorable in vitro potency, selectivity, and promising cellular activity.

biological.citation: Transcriptomic profiles of single-cell autophagy-related genes (ATGs) in lung diseases (PMID: 39920481)
biological.summary: MAP2K7 expression is significantly altered in lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD) compared to normal lung tissues, identified through single-cell RNA sequencing analysis. MAP2K7 is among disease-associated changes in autophagy-related gene expression in lung cancer.
biological.sample_size: healthy subjects and patients with COVID-19, IPF, COPD, SSC, and LUAD

biological.citation: Expression and Clinical Significance of MAPK8, MAPK9, MAP2K4, and MAP2K7 Genes in Colorectal Cancer (PMID: 41515982)
biological.summary: MAP2K7 gene expression is significantly elevated in colorectal cancer tumor specimens with higher histological grades. Bioinformatics analysis confirms that MAP2K7 promotes tumor aggressiveness and metastasis, making it a potential biomarker for CRC progression.

biological.citation: miR-128-3p suppresses tumor growth and enhances chemosensitivity in tongue squamous cell carcinoma through MAP2K7 targeting (PMID: 39476205)
biological.summary: MAP2K7 is a direct target of miR-128-3p validated through luciferase reporter assays. Increased miR-128-3p expression inhibits TSCC cell migration, proliferation, and EMT by suppressing MAP2K7 in the JNK/MAP kinase pathway, and enhances cisplatin sensitivity by reducing c-Jun and ABC transporter expression.
biological.sample_size: tongue squamous cell carcinoma cell lines

biological.citation: Inhibition of the MAP2K7-JNK pathway with 5Z-7-oxozeaenol induces apoptosis in T-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia (PMID: 34504651)
biological.summary: MAP2K7 is validated as a therapeutic target in T-ALL; the small molecule inhibitor 5Z-7-oxozeaenol induces dose-dependent cytotoxicity in T-ALL cell lines through MAP2K7-JNK pathway inhibition. MAP2K7 activation is associated with leukemia-initiating cell expansion and poor prognosis, and its inhibition downregulates G2/M checkpoint regulators and survival pathways.
biological.sample_size: T-ALL cell lines, mouse models, and patient-derived xenograft cells
